summary: Aspen Insurance Holdings, a wholly owned subsidiary of Sompo International, furnished a Form 6-K reporting privately negotiated purchases of its own preferred securities on October 30, 2026. It bought 1,066,000 5.625% Perpetual Non-Cumulative Preference Shares (AHL PRD) and 2,798,000 depositary shares (AHL PRE, each 1/1000th of a preference share) at $18.30 per share, for aggregate consideration of $19,507,800 and $51,203,400 respectively. The company notified the NYSE it intends to cancel the repurchased shares on November 13, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for further open-market preferred repurchases, cancellation mechanics post-November 13, and any signal on capital management priorities.
